prompt:
Create one finished portrait English reading card for middle- and high-school readers. Sophisticated original literary gouache and watercolor editorial illustration, subtle paper grain, refined typography, NOT a preschool picture book. Upper 45% full illustration: Mature young-adult editorial gouache illustration, muted indigo and warm cream: a Korean teenage girl with chin-length straight black hair and a plain navy school cardigan sits at a school desk, quietly folding a test paper into an open book while classmates talk in the soft-focus background. Sensitive restrained expression, no readable grades or other lettering. Lower 55% warm cream reading panel. Clearly printed dark navy serif typography, generous margins, large enough for comfortable reading. Print exact book title "More Than a Grade", smaller page heading "The Result" (omit repeated heading if identical), and page indicator "1 / 3". Then print this exact English text verbatim, preserving stanza breaks for the poem and using comfortable line wrapping for prose:
When I received my science test, I looked only at the grade. It was lower than I expected. Around me, friends compared their results. I folded the paper and hid it inside my book. I had spent a whole week preparing. For a moment, that single number seemed to say that all my effort had been a waste.
All text must fit fully and remain exceptionally legible. No Korean text, no other captions, no brands, no existing fictional characters, no imitation of named artists, no copied compositions. For SF maintain the same original characters: boy short black hair, navy blazer, silver watch; girl black ponytail, gray cardigan; woman science coach rust cardigan. Oval lab gate uses twin metal arcs, separate small brass-and-teal message machine.
